component: IMAP and mailbox message URI parsing

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The IMAP parser bounds its last-hash search before an appended imap:// segment and ends the key at /?&. The mailbox parser uses the first hash and ?&. Removing MsgFindCharInSet only directs these calls to their string receivers; it does not unify those protocol contracts or validate every suffix/key. Folder-prefix changes and key conversion remain separate steps. No parser or protocol test ran.
title: Message URI key parsing keeps protocol-specific hash and suffix boundaries
